name: ea-assistant
description: End-to-end Enterprise Architecture engagement management — TOGAF 10 ADM lifecycle, Zachman classification, ArchiMate notation. Architecture landscape levels (Strategic/Segment/Capability/Solution), structured phase interviews, artifact generation, motivation framework with dedicated driver/goal/objective/strategy registers, Decision Register, ADR management, ARB meeting minutes, workshop facilitation, Risk Register, Cost Model Register and Business Case (architecture-grade TCO/payback costing), persona-tailored menus and reports (CIO, CISO, CPO, Business/Data Architect), two-score artifact scoring (completeness + quality, per section and overall), EA tool import (Sparx XMI, Archi, LeanIX), engagement brief, and consolidated reporting.
